data_fields.name: max_aim_range

data_fields.name: grenade_pitch_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: no aim when v_angle_x is non-zero

best_idea: A cone-plus-visibility lock-on that picks the most central visible enemy and snaps only the vertical angle to the target's height, computed on the server from one aim point.
decision_why: Keep the cone, the visible-only test, the most-central choice and the vertical-only snap, computed on the server (server-verified kills); fix the aim-point mismatch, add a max range as zone data, replace the sentinel with an explicit enable flag, keep the noaim opt-out. Projectile speed/lead rejected for now (fight is melee-first).
acceptance: At 375 wide in a duel: a shot aimed up to about 21 degrees off a foe at a different height lands on the foe and takes the foe's height while the hero's yaw is unchanged; a foe behind a pillar is not chosen; assist off gives the raw facing. Server test: fixed positions give the expected target id and direction; a blocked target returns null.
